description: A thread by any of its Message-IDs, oldest first. Each message: from, to, cc, date, message_id, decoded body (default own words: quotes, signature, inline patch removed; full_text=true for all; never raw MIME), attachments [{index, filename, content_type, size}], has_patch. 20 messages per page (limit max 500; offset, next_offset, has_more); bodies cut at max_body_chars (body_truncated). include_body=false: an outline with attachments and has_patch. Cite https://postgr.es/m/<message_id>.

full_text.description: Whole decoded text, quotes included (default false: own words)

include_body.description: Default true; false: outline (headers, attachments, has_patch)

message_id.description: Any message of the thread: Message-ID or URL

name: get_thread
